checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan + implement cached cpu::detect() for decode dispatch

impact_assessment.why: detect() reran CPUID and topology enumeration ~200x per decode token, absorbed into the norm phase
impact_assessment.benefits: fewer syscalls per token; load-proof decode speedup with zero arithmetic change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: detect() return type changes to const ref; dependency: none; concurrency: function-local static init is thread-safe; state: cached info is process-lifetime
impact_assessment.mitigation: differential via identical generated text, new caching regression test, full gates and interleaved A/B
